title: QDT Review Item
description: Unified review item used across mixed-renderer, scholar-translator, Rust bridge, and frontend.

page.description: 1-indexed page number in the source document

severity.description: info = advisory, warning = should fix, blocking = must fix before delivery

source_text.description: Original English text (truncated to 200 chars in audit)

translated_text.description: Korean translation (truncated to 200 chars in audit)

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this item is flagged

status.description: open = needs review, approved = accepted, rejected = needs re-translation, resolved = fixed

fitted.description: Whether the translated text fits in the original PDF layout box
